n: 36 In. 4.6 Cu. Ft. Legacy Dual Fuel Range With Gas Cooktop And Electric Convection Oven In Black Stainless Steel With 6 Brass Burners
desc: The ZLINE 36 in. 4.6 cu. ft. Legacy Dual Fuel Range with Gas Cooktop and Electric Convection Oven in Black Stainless Steel with 6 Brass Burners (RAB-BR-36) pairs a powerful gas cooktop with 6 Italian-crafted brass burners and an electric convection oven with a Landscape oven door window design. With innovative features designed to enhance your kitchen’s capability, ZLINE Legacy Dual Fuel Ranges provide a professional culinary experience by pairing unmatched performance with timeless style.
hl: The Legacy Professional Range Series represents the foundation for ZLINE’s family-focused mission of attainable luxury
Industry-leading gas cooktop includes 6 hand-cast Italian brass burners with 1,000 - 18,000 BTUs of cooking power
Optimize every meal with even heat distribution thanks to high-performance technology of a gas cooktop and an electric convection oven
ZLINE Legacy Series ranges feature a sleek Landscape oven door design that provides ample viewing space to ensure your dishes are perfectly cooked
A 4.6 cu. ft oven fits pans up to 27 in. wide for maximum space and convenience with everyday cooking
Triple layered glass and an aluminum mesh seal offers superior heat retention and consistent temperatures
spec: 1 year parts and service, limited lifetime warranty on burners
(6) Burners with Porcelain Cook Top with electronic spark ignition for all burners
